question: For ports that are DOWN, return the port ID, tenant ID, MAC address, and the running sum of the port’s standard attribute ID within each security group (ordered by standard attribute ID), and for those same MAC addresses also show the administratively up port name, port security enabled status, and the row number ordered by MAC address using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row. Additionally, group the results by whether the port is in an “External” or “Internal” security-group category (treat security groups whose ID starts with '000' as “External”, otherwise “Internal”), and include subtotals per category and a grand total of matched MAC addresses. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH down_ports AS (
  SELECT
    p.id AS port_id,
    p.tenant_id,
    p.mac_address,
    SUM(p.standard_attr_id) OVER (PARTITION BY sgb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.standard_attr_id) AS running_sum_std_attr,
    CASE WHEN sgb.security_group_id LIKE '000%' THEN 'External' ELSE 'Internal' END AS sg_category
  FROM ports p
  JOIN securitygroupportbindings sgb ON p.id = sgb.port_id
  WHERE p.status = 'DOWN'
),
admin_up_ports AS (
  SELECT
    p.mac_address,
    p.name AS port_name,
    psb.port_security_enabled,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY p.mac_address) AS mac_row_num
  FROM ports p
  JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON p.id = psb.port_id
  WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1
)
SELECT
  dp.port_id,
  dp.tenant_id,
  dp.mac_address,
  dp.running_sum_std_attr,
  aup.port_name,
  aup.port_security_enabled,
  aup.mac_row_num,
  dp.sg_category,
  COUNT(DISTINCT dp.mac_address) AS mac_count
FROM down_ports dp
LEFT JOIN admin_up_ports aup ON dp.mac_address = aup.mac_address
GROUP BY
  dp.port_id,
  dp.tenant_id,
  dp.mac_address,
  dp.running_sum_std_attr,
  aup.port_name,
  aup.port_security_enabled,
  aup.mac_row_num,
  dp.sg_category
WITH ROLLUP
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN GROUPING(dp.sg_category) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  dp.sg_category,
  dp.port_id

FROM down_ports dp
LEFT JOIN admin_up_ports aup ON dp.mac_address = aup.mac_address
GROUP BY
  dp.port_id,
  dp.tenant_id,
  dp.mac_address,
  dp.running_sum_std_attr,
  aup.port_name,
  aup.port_security_enabled,
  aup.mac_row_num,
  dp.sg_category
WITH ROLLUP
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN GROUPING(dp.sg_category) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  dp.sg_category,
  dp.port_id
